# Kangsanjae / 강산재

A private hanok retreat in Hongcheon, South Korea.
Address: 110, Gorugae-gil, Seo-myeon, Hongcheon-gun, Gangwon State.

- /ko/contact and /en/contact: Booking channel status

Room names and capacities, prices, policies, booking URLs and contact details are awaiting host confirmation. Forms are demonstration-only and do not send or store personal information. Do not infer missing facts.
